svg.title: 238 issues as stars
svg.desc: 238 issues drawn as stars in 15 clusters, one per area: eval harnesses 42, judges & RAG 29, RL rewards 22, agent evals 21, metric libs 20, eval platforms 19, fairness & UQ 18, code & math 13, data pipelines 12, safety 12, autograders 8, forecasting 8, retrieval 7, explainability 4, speech & audio 3. Lit: 20 fixed by a merged pull request, 17 by other people and 3 by me (ringed). Rings: 5 closed without a fix. Dots: 213 open. 229 repositories in 15 areas.

229 repositories in 15 areas; lines join an area's issues in the order filed
